correctness.rationale: The finite augmented simplicial chain complex splits exactly and (S_n)^m-equivariantly by the subset of factors in the augmentation kernel. The deletion differential is zero on such factors and otherwise is the augmented link differential with explicitly describable orientation signs. Links are independence complexes of disjoint unions of smaller paths; the standard three-step suspension recurrence gives a one-dimensional reduced link homology iff every component length is 0 or 2 modulo three. Each support creates a different external tensor product of irreducible standard S_n modules and trivial modules. The published Betti polynomial determines explicit diagonal tensor counts via polynomial identity for infinitely many n, and invariants occur only at empty support. Standalone source code independently checks 2,353 path contributions, 40 modular transposition eigenspace cases, and 45 signed Euler trace cases. Tests supplement, not replace, the proof; no integral assertion.

value.rationale: The result computes a natural complete rational homology invariant of a two-parameter family of polyhedral joins/lexicographic path-clique graph complexes under its full (n!)^m product symmetry, with multiplicity-free irreducible labels, exact degree, diagonal tensor multiplicities, and a period-three invariant-space obstruction. Betti ranks and nonequivariant sphere wedges do not determine any of these fiberwise characters. The product group, support labels, and degree-by-degree classification are mathematically natural and reusable for equivariant constructions.
